in_marathi.name: Dhanji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanji is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhana' meaning wealth or prosperity. This name is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to the bearer.
